hints.title: Traversed History List
hints.text: Maintain an array of visited values and an index pointer pointing to the current position.

hints.title: Lazy Controlled Inorder Traversal
hints.text: When moving next beyond the cached history, continue iterative inorder traversal pushing left children to a stack.

hints.title: Bidirectional Pointer Transitions
hints.text: prev() simply decrements pointer and returns the prior cached value; hasPrev() checks if pointer > 0.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

variables: N: number of nodes in BST
complexity.notes: Each node is pushed to stack once and popped once during lazy traversal, giving amortized O(1) operations.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Re-traversing tree nodes backwards without caching requires parent pointers.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Lazy history buffer bounds memory to O(V) visited nodes rather than precomputing all upfront.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Lazy inorder stack combined with dynamic history caching.
